prior_individual_proof.decision: The complete one-file/two-hunk tooltip fix restores eager ViewContainerRef acquisition after a modern late-injector regression. Untouched Material16 and the owned tooltip already receive and store ViewContainerRef in the constructor, and show passes that same field to ComponentPortal. This is the same root mechanism through the historical public constructor, not an ancestry or import-only argument. The required actual packed case checks eager node/container identity before any show, genuine public portal/component instances and logical container view counts through two show/hide/reopen cycles, retaining the old disabled-empty/manual-constructor dependency checks. Both advertised minimum public portal declarations and implementations support this route. Hydration remains unclaimed: neither source inspection, synthetic validator input nor client TestBed observations certify server/client hydration. Full browser/SSR/floor and release gates remain independent of this finite runtime-required source decision.
